name: io.github.yuridivonis/whoop-mcp-server
title: Whoop MCP Server
description: Ask Claude about your WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain and workouts. Self-hosted, with sign-in.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the server's port on this computer.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Keep synced data and the encrypted WHOOP tokens in a named volume, so they survive restarts.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your WHOOP developer app.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of your WHOOP developer app.

environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: The server's /callback address, also added to your WHOOP app. WHOOP needs an https address, such as a tunnel to this computer.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the sign-in page that protects /mcp, at least 16 characters.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: The address MCP clients use to reach the server. Keep the default when running it on this computer.

environmentVariables.name: ENCRYPTION_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Key for encrypting the stored WHOOP tokens. Defaults to WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET.
